title: Open roles: monthly refresh
brief: Re-run the all-roles roundup each month from joinmassive.com/careers: update the role list and the count, keep or swap the photo.

title: How we work: async-first
brief: Culture card for candidates: written docs and threads, fewer meetings, a team across time zones. Pairs with any open-role post.

title: Interview process, step by step
brief: The stages from application to offer, with typical timing. Needs the real process from the hiring team before it's designed.

title: Know someone? Refer them
brief: A short call for referrals pointing at the careers page; easy for teammates to reshare.

title: Role filled: we hired!
brief: Close the loop on a role post once it's filled, then follow up with the person's Welcome to Massive card.

title: Work anniversary
brief: A still of the Work anniversary video, per teammate: name, photo and years at Massive.

title: Birthday card
brief: A still of the Birthday video for the team channel and socials.

title: Promotion announcement
brief: The welcome card's character sheet as a level-up: a new-role badge with the previous role struck through.

title: Where the team is
brief: A world map with a flag for each country the team works from (_lib/world-paths.js and _brand/flags), plus the country count.

title: Teammate spotlight Q&A
brief: One teammate, three short answers (what they work on, a favourite tool, life outside work) and their photo.

title: Offsite recap collage
brief: A photo grid from a team meetup or offsite, with the place and dates. Needs the photos.

title: Company page follower milestone
brief: The Milestone card for the Massive LinkedIn page when it crosses the next round number.

title: 195+ countries
brief: Network coverage: real-time web access through residential IPs in 195+ countries, over the world map.

title: Company anniversary
brief: Years since founding, with a few highlights from the year. Needs the dates and the highlights.

title: Requests served
brief: One big number (requests, data delivered, customers) with a line of context. Needs a number we're happy to publish.

title: Launch announcement
brief: The Launch teaser's final frame as a still for the launch post.

title: Feature spotlight: Web Render
brief: What Web Render does in one line, three benefits, and a product visual.

title: Feature spotlight: Residential proxies
brief: Residential proxies for technical buyers: coverage, rotation and geo-targeting.

title: What's new this month
brief: A monthly changelog card: three to five shipped items, each with an icon.

title: API in a few lines
brief: A syntax-highlighted request and its response, in the house mono type.

title: Meet us at …
brief: Conference card: event, dates, city, where to find us and who's going.

title: Speaker card
brief: The speaker's photo, the talk title, the event, date and time.

title: SF dinner / meetup invite
brief: An invite for a Bay Area dinner or meetup hosted by the field team: date, area, RSVP link.

title: Event recap
brief: Two or three photos from the event, a thank-you line and one takeaway.

title: Webinar
brief: Title, speakers, date and time zone, and the registration link.

title: Blog quote card
brief: A pull quote from a blog post, with the author and the post title.

title: Data story stat
brief: One finding from Massive research with its chart, for the weekly social posts.

title: Market map teaser
brief: A cropped preview of a new market map from the Market Map tool, its headline, and "full map in the comments".

title: Why AEO is the new SEO
brief: A still of the AEO explainer video for the blog post and LinkedIn.

title: What does consent look like?
brief: A still of the consent explainer video.

title: Partnership announcement
brief: Both logos and the headline, matching the Partnership Post tool's look.

title: Customer quote
brief: A customer's quote with their name, title, company logo and photo. Needs the customer's approval.

title: Case study number
brief: One result from a customer story (a success rate, a cost saved) with the customer's logo.

title: Holiday greetings
brief: A still of the Holiday greetings video for December.

title: Happy New Year
brief: A New Year card with the year big, in the house style.
